lines: * [FEATURE] Query-frontend: Add the experimental `-query-frontend.cardinality-estimation-cache.*` flags to store cardinality estimates in a dedicated memcached cache instead of the results cache. Disabled by default. #17173

* [FEATURE] Distributor: Ingest valid samples and native histograms even when other samples in the same series fail validation. Previously, the entire series was discarded. The metrics `cortex_discarded_samples_total` and `cortex_discarded_attributed_samples_total` now count each discarded sample or histogram. #17151

* [FEATURE] Ingester: Add experimental label churn detection, which shows the label names whose values create the most new series on the `/ingester/tsdb/{tenant}/label_churn` page. Enable it with `-ingester.label-churn-enabled`. #17080 #17403

+* [FEATURE] Store-gateway: Add the experimental `-blocks-storage.bucket-store.posting-offsets-in-mem-sampling-cardinality-threshold` flag to reduce the memory used by loaded index-headers for high-cardinality labels. Disabled by default. #17421

* [ENHANCEMENT] Ingester: The `/ingester/ring` page links each ingester to its `/ingester/tenants` page, set with the experimental `-ingester.ring.status-page-ingester-link-template`. The `/ingester/tenants` page shows and sorts by the head series of each tenant. The `/ingester/tsdb/{tenant}` page links to the label churn of the tenant when it's enabled. #17285
* [ENHANCEMENT] API: OTLP translation headers (`-api.otlp-translation-headers-enabled`) are now stable and no longer experimental. The flag remains disabled by default. #17076
* [ENHANCEMENT] Store-gateway: Emit exponential native histograms for `cortex_bucket_stores_blocks_sync_seconds` alongside existing classic buckets. #17077

+// cardinalityCappedLen returns the number of sampled entries to retain for a label with n sampled entries.
+// The label's cardinality is estimated as n*sampleFactor. Up to the threshold, all n entries are retained.
+// Above it, the retained count grows logarithmically. Both the count and its slope are continuous at the threshold,
+// so a label with more values never retains fewer entries than a label with fewer values.
+	// At least the first and the last entries are always retained.
+	// Above nCap, the retained count is nCap*(1+ln(n/nCap)).
+	// At n = nCap it equals nCap, the same as the uncapped count n, so there is no jump at the threshold.
+	// Each extra sampled entry adds nCap/n retained entries: 1 at the threshold, and less as n grows.
+	// So the retained count always increases with n, but slower and slower.
+	// Because ln(x) <= x-1, the formula never exceeds n; min only guards against float rounding.
